articles.title: 🔎 Under the Radar: Tyson Stock Plunges as Beef Business Weighs on Outlook
articles.summary: Shares of Tyson Foods slumped 7% Thursday after the meatpacker said it expects steeper losses in its beef business for the fiscal year. With its fiscal year ending this month, the company now says it plans to lose between $625 million and $775 million in its beef business. A cattle shortage in the U.S. is driving up beef prices and squeezing meatpacker’s profits.
